title: Virtual DOM diff+patch
description:
Implement a minimal virtual DOM with diffing and patching.

- `createElement(tag, props, children)` — returns a vdom node `{ tag, props, children }`; `children` is an array of nodes or strings
- `diff(oldTree, newTree)` — returns an array of patch objects describing what changed
- `patch(el, patches)` — applies the patches to a real DOM element in-place

Patch types to support:
- `{ type: 'SET_PROP', key, value }` — set a property/attribute
- `{ type: 'REMOVE_PROP', key }` — remove a property/attribute
- `{ type: 'SET_TEXT', value }` — replace text content of a text node child

**Example:**
```js
const v1 = createElement('div', { id: 'app' }, ['hello']);
const v2 = createElement('div', { id: 'app', class: 'box' }, ['world']);
const patches = diff(v1, v2);
// patches includes SET_PROP for class and SET_TEXT for text change
```
ai_context: Common mistake: writing diff/patch as a single recursive DOM mutation instead of separating the pure diff step (vdom to vdom, returns patch list) from the patch step (applies to real DOM). Also missing the REMOVE_PROP case when old props are not in new props.
